description: DT12_UC3_Riga's Public Transport Route list data_GTFS_EMERALDS is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Grupa93 Ltd.. This dataset was used in Work Package 5: Use Cases Experimentation and Assessment Cycle, within UC3: Traffic Data Analytics for the Public Transportation System, as part of the EMERALDS project. The dataset provides anonymised information about public transport route list data in GTFS txt file format in different time periods. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
